1991: The Sjöbopartiet did not fill one seat in Sjöbo.
1998: The Left Party did not fill three seats in 1998, two in Mjölby and one in Bromölla.
2002: The Liberal Party did not fill three seats, one in Håbo and two in Olofström. The election to the Municipal Council in Orsa was appealed against and carried out again. The results presented here refers to the re-election in Orsa, held on 16 March 2003.
2006: Sverigedemokraterna did not fill 1 seat in Södertälje, Östhammar, Uppvidinge, Borgholm, Hultsfred, Svedala, Munkedal, Skara, Lekeberg, Nora, Kungsör, Surahammar and 2 seats in Tomelilla.
2010: The Green Party did not fill two seats: one in Boxholm and one in Örkelljunga. The Sweden Democats did not fill seven seats: two in Aneby, one in Bräcke, one in Degerfors, one in Flen, one in Munkedal and one in Nora. The election to the Municipal Council in Örebro was appealed against and a re-election took place for the northeast constituency on May 15, 2011. The results presented here refer to the re-election in 2011.
2014: Update 2019-11-11: The election to the Municipal Council in Båstad was appealed against and a re-election took place on May 10, 2015. The results presented here refer to the ordinary election in 2014.
